accepted.reason: Two JPEG crates patched after the Independent JPEG Group's code (rhwp-zune-jpeg, rhwp-jpeg-encoder): use and redistribution with the acknowledgement kept. Accepted for this WebAssembly by the decision to take rhwp 0.9.0 (2026-11-18).
The licences of the fonts rhwp's own notices name. The licence the app already accepts for fonts (notices.ts).
DejaVu Sans, declared in the source of a crate of the WebAssembly (the PDF backend); rhwp keeps its notice whether or not the font is built in.

Outlines taken from Latin Modern Math 1.959 for formulas, and a subset of it under another name: free to use and distribute with the notice kept (LPPL 1.3c with no maintenance clause). Named in the decision to take rhwp 0.9.0.

The advance widths of Nimbus Roman, numbers taken from URW's Base35 font programs, whose own licence is AGPL-3 with a font exception. No font program and no outline is in the WebAssembly; rhwp keeps the notice with the numbers. Named in the decision to take rhwp 0.9.0.

The advance widths of Helvetica from Adobe's Core 14 AFM files: free to use, copy and distribute with the copyright notices and Adobe's note kept (rhwp-adobe-afm.txt, which rhwp's package leaves out).

leftOut.reason: A licence as a PDF, of a web font of rhwp's own editor. The font is not in the WebAssembly and the app ships none of rhwp's fonts.
